pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark, polygonal regions with relatively sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries. Shapes are predominantly quadrangular and pentagonal on the mid-neck and shoulder, exhibiting high spatial area relative to separating corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes are clearly visible as tri-valent or tetra-valent intersections. Pixel thickness of corridors is relatively uniform across the neck and upper flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible as a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background, consistent with a short mane. The profile is intermittently obscured by multiple perched avian organisms.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small birds (oxpeckers) perched on the upper neck and shoulder region, creating localized protrusions on the dorsal ridge and lateral surface.
